limitation: Uplift fit and predictive ranking alone do not establish identification
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Experimental or observational (X,T,Y) with a separately established causal design.
scientific_qualification.output: Method-specific heterogeneous-effect predictions used as inputs to targeting analysis.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Exchangeability, support and treatment consistency; CATE estimation and policy evaluation have separate accuracy and uncertainty requirements.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Limit the current qualification to the documented CATE/uplift role and benchmark facilities. Preserve method/target definitions; do not certify a policy from uplift ranking alone. Detailed method APIs require additional inspection before implementation.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Evaluate effect calibration and held-out policy value under known heterogeneous effects and a confounded challenger; separate treatment-response prediction from causal ranking.

evidence.finding: CATE/uplift purpose, experimental API warning and benchmark dataset/metric declarations.
